decisions.reason: As a compliance-related add-on close to the core offer, with its own page and at least some positive agency feedback, management is likely to justify and continue it rather than admit an early mistake.
Because it builds directly on the core hosting business and was promoted on the home page, it represents a visible strategic commitment that escalation of commitment makes especially hard to reverse.

A configurable managed hosting plan fits the firm’s established infrastructure and customer base, so after launching it on its own page management is likely to keep backing it unless clear failure emerges.
